notes.title: JetPack Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

In this update changes was made to improve the current Vehicle on how it handles

A new vehicle being worked on and will be in this weekends update

New added to this update is the Jetpack that can be found in high tear loot crates or crafted on the work bench

The Controls to fly will be on the right bottom corner when you wear the jetpack

There will be a performance update this weekend to add more FPS to the map and cleanup on code
If you do jump back during flight you can fly in first person using (V)



Thank you

Dean

NB--- If by any chance you do get a error when launching the game just clear out your save game on your C:\Users\yourpcname\AppData\Local/sustained and you are good to go. ( it doesn't happen to everyone but just so you do know if it does happen to you)

notes.title: Map Changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone

Here is whats in this update:

Removed the snow biome as from now on storms will start randomly so it would be best to get warm as a storm can happen at anytime, snow or rain storm.
New foliage was added to the terrain
Performance on landscape and meshes for better FPS
More trees was added to the landscape
New map image explaining areas and what to find in areas
Performance fixes to Character code

In the next update

In next update storms will destroy parts of your base if its still in wood but not if its stone or metal
The city will be expanded to a way bigger city and the buildings will have more access to the other floors
More vehicles
Jetpack will be added but will use fuel
3 new poi's will be added to the world


Thank you 

Please if you find any bugs please join the discord and report them


NB--- If by any chance you do get a error when launching the game just clear out your save game on your C:\Users\yourpcname\AppData\Local/sustained and you are good to go. ( it doesn't happen to everyone but just so you do know if it does happen to you)

notes.title: Steam Is broken Cant Update my game
notes.notes:
Hi

Its been 3 days trying to send out a update for Sustained with no luck, Steam started using SMS to send out your update to verify your account but I am not receiving any SMS to do so

https://gameworldobserver.com/2023/10/12/steam-sms-verification-game-builds-security

I dont know what to do from here as for the last 3 days I am not getting any response from steam to get this resolved.

This is very unprofessional and makes me look bad as a developer trying to get patch fixes out ASAP

If anyone has any ideas on what I can do please give me a shout out in my discord
If you can try to contact steam support to get them to sort this out I think this will also help


Sorry for this guys but its not in my hands as the update is ready but no support from steam

Thank you
